messages:
joan: quick follow-up from the postmortem 19. want to convert remediation items into tests and owners.

sam: i'll take the prompt regression tests. plan: capture the top-40 incident prompts with full system context + seed, add a golden-prefix check and a fuzzy similarity fallback. estimate 5 business days.

eli: i'll own the load/chaos pieces. propose a short chaos drill: 10m at 75% peak qps, evict KV caches, and restart 30% of pods staggered over 2m. run as dry-run first. need eng-sre OK.

joan: required artifacts: promptset JSONL (id, seed, system, expected_prefix), CI job snippet, nightly regression pipeline entry, k6 load script, chaos runbook + rollback steps, and SLIs.

eng-sre-bot: ack. eng-sre will provide baseline latency and cache metrics and mark a safe window.

marta: acceptance criteria examples: promptset pass-rate >= 96% (token-prefix or rouge-l >= 0.9), nightly run should sample heavy models <= 20% to control cost, chaos dry-run must not exceed 1% error delta over baseline.

sam: adding promptset checksum and deterministic-seed field to prevent drift. CI will fail if checksum mismatch.

eli: timeline suggestion: promptset + CI in 7 days, nightly job + dashboard in 10 days, chaos dry-run in 14 days. owners confirm?

sam: confirm 7 days for promptset.

marta: confirm overall timeline. i'll create ML-REG-210 and add sub-tasks. include acceptance criteria and cost-sampling flag.

joan: small note: please include original user utterance and any assistant pre-prompt in the promptset entry to ensure fidelity.

eng-sre-bot: reminder: ML-REG-188 has 1 open action older than 4 days. update tickets to avoid overlap.

marta: thanks all  closing loop, will post PRD and ticket link in the postmortem doc. ping me if timelines slide.
